synthesis: The Live Hits Pending Repossession card (driver dashboard and its admin Bird's-Eye analogue) does not show the hotlist vehicle description (year/make/model + state) when tapped, even though the identical field set is shown when a normal map pin is tapped. Both the card and the pin ultimately store the already-fetched hit object verbatim into the Pinia map store's selectedHit, and the same MapShell.vue detail sheet renders both. The divergence is NOT a query/data problem — it is a pure JSON-projection omission: ClarityScoutDashboardController::recentHits() and its admin twin ClarityScoutBirdsEyeController::recentHits() build their ->map() response array without vehicle_year, vehicle_make, vehicle_model, or hotlist_us_state, while the sibling hits() methods on ClarityScoutMapController and ClarityScoutBirdsEyeController already include exactly those four keys. The underlying ClickHouse row ($hit, from Hit::forWindow()->hot()/cold() with a plain Eloquent ->get() and no restrictive ->select()) already carries all four columns for every code path examined, and MapShell.vue's vehicleLabel computed + render gate already read the exact snake_case keys the hits() methods emit. So the intended outcome is: add the four keys to both recentHits() ->map() closures; no query change and no Vue change is required.

scope.summary: Add vehicle_year, vehicle_make, vehicle_model, hotlist_us_state to the ->map() projection in ClarityScoutDashboardController::recentHits() (driver) and ClarityScoutBirdsEyeController::recentHits() (admin Bird's-Eye), matching the key set and casing already emitted by ClarityScoutMapController::hits() and ClarityScoutBirdsEyeController::hits(). Columns are already loaded on the Eloquent-Clickhouse $hit object (no ->select() restriction anywhere in the recentHits query chain), so this is a pure array-literal addition with no query change and no frontend change (MapShell.vue already reads these exact keys defensively).

notes: Ticket's exact line-number claims were verified against current main (this worktree, HEAD 0d332ac4, 2026-07-17) and are accurate: ClarityScoutDashboardController::recentHits ->map() is at L140-150 (ticket said ~L140-150), ClarityScoutBirdsEyeController::recentHits ->map() is at L571-583 (ticket said ~L572-583, off by one line but same closure), ClarityScoutBirdsEyeController::hits ->map() is at L327-341 (exact match), ClarityScoutMapController::hits ->map() is at L250-266 (exact match). Per DEV-2137's lesson, all four were independently re-verified rather than trusted from the ticket text.

Both recentHits() queries use ClickhouseHit::hot()/forWindow() -> newQuery() -> ... -> get() with NO ->select() call anywhere in the chain, so Eloquent issues an unrestricted SELECT (all columns). The hits_hot/hits_cold ClickHouse tables (database/schema/clickhouse-schema.sql:131, okf/models/clickhouse/hits_cold.md) define vehicle_year, vehicle_make, vehicle_model, hotlist_us_state as real Nullable(String) columns on the row, so the 'already loaded' claim in the ticket is TRUE — this is a pure ->map() projection fix, not a query change.

MapShell.vue's vehicleLabel computed (resources/js/clarity-scout/components/MapShell.vue:145-148) reads hit?.vehicle_year / hit?.vehicle_make / hit?.vehicle_model, and the render gate at line 47 checks vehicleLabel || mapStore.selectedHit.hotlist_us_state — exact snake_case keys, matching what hits() already emits. No casing mismatch exists and no Vue change is needed; once the backend emits the 4 keys the existing template renders them for free.

The card and pin share ONE Vue component (DashboardOverlay.vue) and ONE Pinia store shape: selectHitFromCard(hit) in DashboardOverlay.vue calls mapStore.focusHit(hit) -> setSelectedHit(hit), which stores the raw fetched object verbatim (resources/js/clarity-scout/stores/map.js:617-631); the pin click in ScannerMap.vue calls mapStore.setSelectedHit(hit) directly from mapStore.rangeHits (fed by /map/hits). Both driver and admin (Bird's-Eye) modes reuse the identical DashboardOverlay.vue + dashboard.js store; buildUrl() in lib/fetch.js swaps only the BASE_URL prefix (/api/scout vs /scout/org-map/api) based on window.__CLARITY_SCOUT_CONFIG__.birdsEye, so the fix must land in BOTH backend recentHits() methods to cover both surfaces.

ClarityScoutTripsController's two hit-detail builders (day() L355-370, show() L470-482) were checked as a sibling pattern and are ALREADY correct — their queries explicitly ->select(['ocr','hit_created_at','hit_type','lat','lng','scan_guid','vehicle_year','vehicle_make','vehicle_model','hotlist_us_state']) and their ->map() already emits all 4 fields. Confirms the fix pattern (match the sibling) and confirms trip markers are unaffected/out of scope.

Existing test test_can_get_recent_hits (ClarityScoutDashboardControllerTest.php:296-312) currently asserts a jsonStructure WITHOUT the 4 fields — it currently pins the buggy behavior and must be widened (not just left passing) as part of the fix, per repo test-enforcement convention (every change must be programmatically tested).

Status target is staging only, not prod — no feature-flag or environment gate was found guarding recentHits(); this is a plain code fix that will ship to whatever environment the branch deploys to. If a staging-only gate is actually required, that would need explicit product/eng guidance (not found in the ticket or code) — flagging for awareness even though it isn't a blocking question since nothing in the code or ticket suggests a mechanism for env-gating a single controller method.

Repo convention: match sibling ->map() key order/style exactly (as done in hits()) and run `vendor/bin/pint --dirty --format agent` after editing per CLAUDE.md Laravel Boost guidance; do not add comments beyond the existing DEV-XXXX-referencing doc-block style already used in these files.
